overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Dynamic Lugano Elite 3-Person Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a premium wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for relaxation and health benefits, this sauna features 9 ultra-low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels strategically placed to promote muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Constructed from elegant Honey Dark Stain Canadian Hemlock wood, it includes advanced features like an interior chromotherapy lighting system and Bluetooth connectivity for a personalized spa experience. Ideal for indoor spaces such as basements or fitness rooms, this sauna combines luxury and functionality with its easy clasp-together assembly and sleek design.

_raw.Product Ad-Copy: Dynamic Saunas are constructed of environmentally-friendly Canadian Hemlock wood planks. Our saunas feature energy PureTech™ Ultra-Low EMF Heating Technology that help relax and rejuvenate the body. Dynamic Saunas can be installed on carpet or any indoor location including basements, master bath, walk in closet or can also be added it to a fitness room.
